note: One entry per game sprite. QT Gamer generates entries whose status is 'todo' (two variants, automatic checks, QT Manager pixel review, then owner Approve/Reject on Telegram). 'done' entries were generated and owner-approved in the 18 Oct 2026 test run.

assets.subject: a knobbly piece of fresh ginger root
assets.details: Pale golden-tan skin with soft ring marks and two small green leaves tucked beside it.

assets.subject: two whole bulbs of garlic
assets.details: Creamy white papery skin with faint violet streaks, one bulb slightly behind the other.

assets.subject: a small bunch of kangkung (water spinach)
assets.details: Glossy deep green arrow-shaped leaves on pale green hollow stems, loosely bundled.

assets.subject: two fresh carrots
assets.details: Bright orange with soft rings and short leafy green tops, one lying across the other.

assets.subject: soft tofu cubes on a small round wooden plate
assets.details: Four smooth white cubes stacked loosely, with two small bok choy leaves tucked beside them.

assets.subject: three whole shiitake mushrooms
assets.details: Rich brown domed caps with a pale cross-shaped cut on top and short cream stems.

assets.subject: a short round glass jar of red chilli bean paste with a red lid
assets.details: Thick glossy red paste visible through the glass and heaped at the open top; a cream rounded label on the front shows a single large dark red letter 'A'.

assets.subject: a short round glass jar of dark brown bean paste with a brown lid
assets.details: Thick glossy dark brown paste visible through the glass and heaped at the open top; a cream rounded label on the front shows a single large dark brown letter 'B'.

assets.subject: a small classic soy sauce dispenser bottle
assets.details: Rounded glass bottle of very dark soy sauce with a bright red pointed cap. No label.

assets.subject: a small glass jug of golden sesame oil
assets.details: Clear glass with a round body, a handle and a cork stopper, filled with warm amber oil. No label.

assets.subject: a small bottle of kecap manis (sweet soy sauce)
assets.details: Slim dark glass bottle with a red cap and a plain golden-yellow band with no text.

assets.subject: a round wooden bowl heaped with fluffy steamed white rice
assets.details: Plump glossy rice grains in a warm brown wooden bowl.

assets.subject: vegetarian mapo tofu in a round white ceramic bowl
assets.details: Glossy red chilli bean sauce with soft white tofu cubes, small green peas and a few red chilli flecks. No meat.

assets.subject: Office lunch, a young working adult
assets.details: Short neat dark brown hair, a blue knit sweater over a white collar, closed happy upturned-arc eyes, small open smile, both hands resting on the cheeks.

assets.subject: Auntie Mei, a cheerful middle-aged auntie
assets.details: Soft grey hair in a neat round bun on top, a coral knit sweater with a peach apron, closed happy upturned-arc eyes, small open smile, both hands resting on the cheeks.

assets.subject: Auntie Mei, a cheerful middle-aged auntie, politely declining
assets.details: Same look as guest-mei: soft grey hair in a neat round bun, coral knit sweater with a peach apron. Eyebrows slightly raised in apology, small closed wavy mouth, one hand raised palm-out in a gentle 'no thank you' gesture.

assets.subject: Jia Hui, a young adult regular
assets.details: Long dark brown hair in a high ponytail with a few side strands, a sage green knit sweater, closed happy upturned-arc eyes, small open smile, both hands resting on the cheeks.

assets.subject: the back wall of a small sunlit plant-based café, seen from behind the serving counter
assets.details: Only the back wall, from just below the ceiling down to a honey-wood shelf ledge that runs along the very bottom edge. A wide window with soft pale-blue sky, blurred city buildings and round green trees outside; two warm glowing pendant lamps hanging from the top; a dark green chalkboard on the right with a cute white chalk doodle of a smiling steamed bun (bao) and little sparkles; potted green plants, small jars and cups on the ledge. Warm cream walls and honey-wood window frames. Nothing in the foreground: no counter, no table, no stove, no pans, no plates, no food.

assets.subject: the top and front edge of a warm honey-coloured wooden café bar counter
assets.details: Long smooth planks running horizontally across the whole width, soft natural grain, warm honey colour, seen straight on from slightly above; the lower fifth shows the rounded front edge catching a soft highlight. Seamless and evenly lit so it can be stretched horizontally.

assets.subject: an empty round cream ceramic plate
assets.details: Wide gently raised rim, smooth glaze with a soft highlight, seen from slightly above so it reads as a flat ellipse.

assets.subject: a wide wooden plating board made of two square chopping boards side by side
assets.details: Honey-coloured wood with soft grain and rounded corners, completely empty on top (no plates, no food). A folded white tea towel with thin pink stripes and a small sprig of green herbs tucked at the left end.

assets.subject: a square terracotta-orange cooking hob with an empty black carbon-steel wok on it
assets.details: The hob has a softly glowing orange burner ring under the wok and rounded corners. The wok is deep, matte black inside with a soft sheen, completely empty, with a long wooden handle pointing to the right. A small white utensil pot holding wooden spatulas sits at the back right corner of the hob.

assets.subject: vegetarian fried bee hoon (thin rice vermicelli) on a round white plate
assets.details: Golden stir-fried rice vermicelli with shredded cabbage, carrot strips, bean sprouts and a few leafy greens; no egg, no meat, no seafood, no spring onion.

assets.subject: stir-fried kangkung (water spinach) on a round white plate
assets.details: Glossy bright green leaves and tender hollow stems in a light savoury sauce with a few slices of red chilli and ginger; no garlic, no shrimp paste, no meat.
